source_title: How I Got My First Sale on Gumroad
snippet_primary: "Gumroad won't promote your product through their Discover page until you earn your first $10. That means no free exposure from Gumroad unless you prove yourself first."
subject_exact: Gumroad Discover promotion eligibility threshold of $10 in earnings for product listing
